title: Accounts Receivable Policy: RV & Boat Storage Late Fees, Gate Lockout and Lien Notice
content:
An unpaid month of RV & Boat Storage rent attracts late fees, then suspension of gate access, then a preliminary lien notice, each at the point in days set for the space class.

## A. Late fees

The first late fee is charged when a month's rent is still unpaid at the end of the grace period (the grace days after the due day), and the second late fee when it is still unpaid on the second late-fee day; never more than two late fees per month and none on fees.

- Each late fee belongs to the month whose rent is late, and is either that month's first or its second late fee.
- Late fees arise only from unpaid rent. An unpaid fee — a late fee, a returned-payment fee or any other one-time fee — never attracts a late fee of its own.

## B. What "unpaid" means

A month's rent is unpaid on a given day when, measured at the end of that day, the following amount is above zero: that month's rent charge, less the credits posted against that month, less the payments applied to that month's rent when the rental's payments received up to that day are applied to its charges oldest first. The amount is never taken below zero.

*Hypothetical cases for one month's rent of 72.00 with an autopay credit of 3.00 posted against it:*

| Older charges still open | Payments received up to the end of the test day | Applied to this month's rent | Unpaid amount | Unpaid? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | 69.00 | 69.00 | 0.00 | no |
| none | 50.00 | 50.00 | 19.00 | yes |
| a 20.00 fee from an earlier month | 69.00 | 49.00 (20.00 goes first to the older fee) | 20.00 | yes |
| none | 80.00 | 69.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) | no |

## C. Gate lockout and lien notice

Gate access is suspended when a month's rent is unpaid the lockout number of days after its due day, and restored only when the whole past-due balance including fees is paid. While access is suspended the rental is in past-due lockout status; paying the full past-due balance returns it to active.

At the lien-notice number of days past due the preliminary lien notice is sent. The lien sale, towing or release of a unit held under lien are handled only by the community manager, and the resident desk never schedules or negotiates them. A rental that ends after the lien process for an unpaid balance is closed from past-due lockout.

### Points of judgement on release

| Payment made while gate access is suspended | Gate access |
|---|---|
| the whole past-due balance, rent and fees together | restored |
| the past-due rent only, with late fees still owing | stays suspended |
| part of the past-due rent | stays suspended |
